posts.title: 即时 steering 与 GPT-6.1 Sol ultrafast
posts.summary: Tibo 表示已把 steering 做得即时，模型对调整的反应更快，能实时纠偏；同时发布 GPT-6.1 Sol ultrafast。引用的 OpenAI Developers 帖子称 Ultrafast 今天在 API、Codex 和 ChatGPT Work 中为 GPT-6.1 Sol 推出，接近 Astra 智能水平，速度最高可达 Sol Standard 的 8 倍。
posts.originalText:
Day 4/

We have improved steering to be instant, leading to the model now reacting much faster to adjustments you make, allowing you to course-correct direction in realtime and not have the model waste effort.

Also releasing GPT-6.1 Sol ultrafast. The two work very well together.
posts.quotedText:
Ultrafast is rolling out today for GPT-6.1 Sol in the API, Codex, and ChatGPT Work.

Near-Astra intelligence at up to 8x faster speeds than Sol Standard, so you can build as fast as the ideas come. https://t.co/Cyy9k2hifV
posts.titleEn: Instant steering and GPT-6.1 Sol ultrafast
posts.summaryEn: Tibo says steering is now instant so the model reacts faster to adjustments and can course-correct in realtime; GPT-6.1 Sol ultrafast is also releasing. The quoted OpenAI Developers post says Ultrafast is rolling out today for GPT-6.1 Sol in the API, Codex, and ChatGPT Work, with near-Astra intelligence at up to 8x Sol Standard speed.

posts.title: Codex Cloud 悄悄重新上线
posts.summary: Tibo 在第 3 天加场中表示，团队悄悄重新上线了 Codex Cloud，现在相当不错。引用的 Tailscale 帖子介绍，Codex Cloud 现在可以通过 Tailscale 安全连接 tailnet 上的资源。
posts.originalText:
Day 3 (encore)/

We silently re-shipped codex cloud. It’s pretty good now
posts.quotedText:
Codex 🤝 Tailscale

Codex Cloud can now securely connect to resources on your tailnet with Tailscale.

Useful tools should be easy to build with, combine, and turn into something even more useful.

See how it works → 
https://t.co/0eFd37GmmO
posts.summaryEn: In a Day 3 encore, Tibo says the team silently re-shipped Codex Cloud and it is pretty good now. The quoted Tailscale post says Codex Cloud can now securely connect to resources on your tailnet with Tailscale.

posts.title: 4,000 万活跃用户，发放一次储备重置
posts.summary: Tibo 表示第 3 天的重头戏是 ChatGPT 中的 GPT-6；同时 Codex 与 ChatGPT Work 活跃用户创下 4,000 万新高，正在向所有人的付费账号载入一次储备的重置。
posts.originalText:
Day 3/

The big one is GPT-6 in Chat, but today is also a little celebration day with a new high of 40M active users across Codex and ChatGPT Work.

Loading a banked reset in everyone's paid accounts. See you again tomorrow!
posts.quotedText: Roundup of Day 2/ 2.1/ Approve for me (auto-review) is now included and does not use usage. Can be between 2-10% of plan when used. Also better for you. 2.2/ Simplified API for builders. 2.3/ Meeting notes integrated. 2.4/ Decisions API live for builders. Will use in the app to improve the experience.
posts.titleEn: 40M active users, and a banked reset
posts.summaryEn: Tibo says the big one for Day 3 is GPT-6 in ChatGPT; Codex and ChatGPT Work also hit a new high of 40M active users, and a banked reset is being loaded into everyone's paid accounts.

posts.title: 新版 GPT-6 面向所有 ChatGPT 用户推出
posts.summary: 新版 GPT-6 与 Intelligent UI 向所有 ChatGPT 用户推出，回答更可视、可交互，并能当场提供适合任务的交互式工具。Tibo 称这背后是大量模型与基础设施改进，以扩展到 12 亿用户。
posts.originalText: We're going beyond text and are releasing a new version of GPT-6 to all users in ChatGPT. Lots of model and infra improvements coming together here to scale it to 1.2B users!
posts.quotedText:
GPT-6 and Intelligent UI, now rolling out in ChatGPT for everyone.

Intelligent UI in ChatGPT delivers fast, interactive answers that make everyday questions more visual, complex topics easier to grasp, and interactive tools for your task available on the spot. https://t.co/XL2gDCPBwG
posts.titleEn: A new version of GPT-6 rolls out to all ChatGPT users
posts.summaryEn: A new version of GPT-6 and Intelligent UI are rolling out to all ChatGPT users, with more visual, interactive answers and on-the-spot interactive tools for the task. Tibo says many model and infrastructure improvements came together to scale it to 1.2B users.

posts.title: 四项更新之后，额度也重置了
posts.summary: Tibo 在当日投票后宣布使用额度重置已完成。原帖没有列出具体套餐范围或重置窗口。
posts.originalText: We shipped four things that were deemed good to great and some math proofs, but the vote is clear and the community demands a reset. I did calibrate it and it *seems* that the game is rigged in reset's favor, but such are the rules at the moment. Therefore ... the reset has been processed. Enjoy!
posts.quotedText: Roundup of Day 2/ 2.1/ Approve for me (auto-review) is now included and does not use usage. Can be between 2-10% of plan when used. Also better for you. 2.2/ Simplified API for builders. 2.3/ Meeting notes integrated. 2.4/ Decisions API live for builders. Will use in the app to improve the experience.
posts.titleEn: Four updates, followed by a usage reset
posts.summaryEn: After the day’s community vote, Tibo confirmed that the usage reset had been processed. The post did not specify eligible plans or which usage windows were reset.

posts.title: Decisions API 开放公测
posts.summary: 近乎实时地选择模型、工具或操作。官方称，决策速度最高可达通过 Responses API 使用 GPT-6 Luna 的 10 倍。
posts.originalText: Day 2.4/ Decisions API is live. We will use this ourselves to improve the experience for everyone in many fun ways. Realtime general classifier does open some great possibilities.
posts.quotedText: Let your app choose the right model, tool, or action in near real-time with Decisions API, now available to all developers in public beta. The Decisions API makes decisions up to 10x faster than GPT-6 Luna through the Responses API. https://t.co/zhgRVzJ3aP
posts.summaryEn: Choose a model, tool or action in near real time. OpenAI says decisions can be up to 10× faster than GPT-6 Luna through the Responses API.

posts.title: Meetings：会议结束，工作接着往前
posts.summary: 记录会议，结合已有工作生成个性化摘要与下一步事项，保存到 ChatGPT Space。macOS 桌面版 Pro / Business 已开放测试，Enterprise 即将支持。
posts.originalText:
Day 2.3/

Never worry about remembering what you were saying with that colleague. Just talk your heart out and build up the context to load up into codex to get it all done.
posts.titleEn: Meetings: turn conversations into next steps
posts.summaryEn: Record meetings and use existing work context to create personalized summaries and next steps, saved in ChatGPT Space. The macOS desktop beta is available for Pro and Business, with Enterprise support coming later.

posts.title: API 付费等级，五档变三档
posts.summary: 付费使用等级简化为 Build、Launch 和 Grow。最高等级 Grow 的累计 API 付款门槛从 1,000 美元降至 500 美元。
posts.originalText: Day 2.2/ OK this one is smaller, but we removed some friction for when building on the API. Happy building.
posts.quotedText: We’re making it easier to qualify for higher OpenAI API rate limits. Five paid usage tiers become three: Build, Launch, and Grow. You can qualify for Grow, our new highest tier, with $500 in total API payments—down from $1,000 for the previous highest tier. https://t.co/FGZ8mppEJa
posts.titleEn: Five paid API tiers become three
posts.summaryEn: Paid usage tiers are simplified to Build, Launch and Grow. Qualifying for Grow, the highest tier, now requires $500 in total API payments, down from $1,000.

posts.title: Auto-review 免费，不再占用套餐额度
posts.summary: 通过 ChatGPT 账号登录的用户可免费使用自动审核。权限菜单中的名称为「Approve for me」；Default permissions 本身不等同于开启自动审核。
posts.originalText: Day 2.1/ We have made Auto-review free for all users signed in through a ChatGPT account. You can enable it in settings > permissions > auto-review. Auto-review improves upon the default sandbox setting that requires you to approve everything, which is prone to decision fatigue unless you spend a lot of time configuring specific rules. It allows you to run long tasks while having a second agent review all actions taken by the primary agent. Its only goal is to prevent high-risk actions from being taken and to protect against unwanted actions that are not aligned with the original user intent. This Auto-review feature is now free and does not draw usage from your plan.
posts.quotedText: Day 1/ We have optimized the default speed to be ~50% faster across GPT-6 Astra and GPT-6.1 Sol through the subscription across all our products and partners using Sign in With ChatGPT (including OpenCode, Pi, Amp, Devin, ...). No changes needed on your end and this should be felt within the next two hours.
posts.titleEn: Auto-review is free, with no plan usage deducted
posts.summaryEn: Auto-review is free for users signed in with a ChatGPT account. It appears as “Approve for me” in the permissions menu; Default permissions alone does not enable it.

posts.title: 默认速度提升约 50%
posts.summary: GPT-6 Astra 和 GPT-6.1 Sol 的默认速度提升约 50%，覆盖订阅内的产品，以及通过 ChatGPT 登录的合作伙伴。用户无需更改设置。
posts.originalText: Day 1/ We have optimized the default speed to be ~50% faster across GPT-6 Astra and GPT-6.1 Sol through the subscription across all our products and partners using Sign in With ChatGPT (including OpenCode, Pi, Amp, Devin, ...). No changes needed on your end and this should be felt within the next two hours.
posts.quotedText: Over the next 28 days, each day we’ll either ship one thing that is a clear improvement and relevant for most codex/work users or ship a full reset. Let the improvements begin.
posts.summaryEn: GPT-6 Astra and GPT-6.1 Sol are about 50% faster by default across subscription products and partners using Sign in with ChatGPT. No settings changes are needed.

posts.title: 28 天，每天一项改进，或一次额度重置
posts.summary: 未来 28 天，每天推出一项对多数 Codex / Work 用户有帮助的明确改进，或者重置使用额度。
posts.originalText: Over the next 28 days, each day we’ll either ship one thing that is a clear improvement and relevant for most codex/work users or ship a full reset. Let the improvements begin.
posts.titleEn: 28 days: an improvement or a usage reset each day
posts.summaryEn: For the next 28 days, each day will bring a clear improvement relevant to most Codex / Work users, or a reset of usage allowances.

roundups.title: Day 2 · 四项更新，加一次额度重置
roundups.summary: Auto-review 免费、API 等级简化、Meetings 会议记录、Decisions API 公测；随后追加一次使用额度重置。
roundups.titleEn: Day 2 · Four updates and a usage reset
roundups.summaryEn: Free Auto-review, simplified API tiers, Meetings and the Decisions API public beta, followed by a usage reset.

roundups.title: Day 3 · 新版 GPT-6 进入 ChatGPT、储备重置，加场 Codex Cloud
roundups.summary: 新版 GPT-6 与 Intelligent UI 向所有 ChatGPT 用户推出；Codex 与 ChatGPT Work 活跃用户达 4,000 万新高，所有付费账号载入一次储备重置；加场悄悄重新上线 Codex Cloud，可通过 Tailscale 连接 tailnet 资源。
roundups.titleEn: Day 3 · New GPT-6 in ChatGPT, a banked reset, and an encore for Codex Cloud
roundups.summaryEn: A new version of GPT-6 and Intelligent UI roll out to all ChatGPT users; Codex and ChatGPT Work hit 40M active users, and a banked reset is loaded into all paid accounts; an encore quietly re-ships Codex Cloud, which can now connect to tailnet resources via Tailscale.
